hebrewText: אָרְחִ֣/י וְ/רִבְעִ֣/י זֵרִ֑יתָ וְֽ/כָל דְּרָכַ֥/י הִסְכַּֽנְתָּה

tokens.bdb: a well-trodden road (literally or figuratively); also a caravan
tokens.kjv: manner, path, race, rank, traveller, troop, (by-, high-) way.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a well-trodden road ; also a caravan
tokens.enLiteralWord: a well-trodden road ; also a caravan
tokens.explanation: a well-trodden road ; also a caravan
tokens.explanationEn: a well-trodden road ; also a caravan

tokens.bdb: to toss about; by implication, to diffuse, winnow
tokens.kjv: cast away, compass, disperse, fan, scatter (away), spread, strew, winnow.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
tokens.kjv: along, away, because of, [phrase] by, conversation, custom, (east-) ward, journey, manner, passenger, through, toward, (high-) (path-) way(-side), whither(-soever).

tokens.bdb: to be familiar with; by implication, to minister to, be serviceable to, be customary
tokens.kjv: acquaint (self), be advantage, [idiom] ever, (be, (un-)) profit(-able), treasurer, be wont.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to be familiar with; by implication
tokens.enLiteralWord: to be familiar with; by implication
tokens.explanation: to be familiar with; by implication
tokens.explanationEn: to be familiar with; by implication
